mainEntity.name: Can I continue treatment while my case is pending?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. In fact, continuing treatment as recommended is often critical. Gaps or early termination of care may be used by insurers to argue that injuries were minor, exaggerated, or have been resolved.
